preconditions.description: The graph has n nodes and m edges, where n is at least 1 and m is between n-1 and 5e5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the valid range.
The input contains exactly m edges.
The graph is a cactus (connected, no edge lies on more than one simple cycle).

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer less than 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == str((p * pow(q, -1, MOD)) % MOD) for some p, q where variance = p/q in reduced form and q not divisible by MOD
postconditions.description: The output is the modular inverse of the variance of X, where X is the number of connected components after random node removal.

postconditions.expression: variance == E[(X - E[X])^2] where X is the number of connected components after each node is removed independently with probability 1/2
postconditions.description: The output correctly computes the variance of X modulo 10^9 + 7.
